name: Mold temperature controller
summary: Circulates temperature-controlled water or oil through the mold to hold a stable mold surface temperature.

name: Dehumidifying dryer
summary: Dries hygroscopic resins (PA, PC, PET, PBT, ABS) with low-dew-point air from a desiccant rotor.

name: Hot air dryer
summary: Removes surface moisture from non-hygroscopic resins (PP, PE, PS) using heated ambient air.

name: Chiller
summary: Supplies chilled water to molds and machine oil coolers using a refrigeration circuit.

name: Mold dehumidifier
summary: Blankets the mold area with dry air to stop condensation when molds run with chilled water.

name: Conveying system
summary: Vacuum loaders and centralized conveying that move resin from storage or dryers to machines.

name: Recycling granulator
summary: Beside-the-press and central granulators that regrind sprues, runners and rejects for reuse.
